Everything here about "Monopoly 200X" comes from official Ohio lottery numbers, current through November 14.
696.headline: How this game pays out

762.body:
"Billion" has had no $20 million top prize claimed since we started watching it. Everyday prizes keep getting claimed, and fewer tickets are left each day. The number of tickets printed is fixed. Each day without a top prize claim leaves those prizes among fewer tickets.

Every line of Billion's prize table below shows today's count, not last month's.
762.headline: No new top prize claims

827.body:
The most common win left on "50th Anniversary" is $100. The second biggest prize left is $1 million, and two of those are still unclaimed. The prize table is what defines a scratcher, and this page counts every level of it.

How far "50th Anniversary" is through its run does not decide anything by itself. It changes how closely to look at the other numbers.

The numbers for "50th Anniversary" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
827.headline: A close look at the prizes

847.body:
The $500,000 top prize on "Bingo 50X" is no longer available because all four have been claimed. The biggest prize anyone can win today is $100,000. Use that amount when you decide.

The numbers for "Bingo 50X" will change a little by tomorrow, and this page will change with them.
847.headline: Big prize shown, none left

891.body:
"Cash Explosion 25X" has 83,310 prizes of $5 still unclaimed, which is its most common win. Just below the top prize is the $10,000 prize, with one left. The full count for every prize level is listed below.

The numbers for "Cash Explosion 25X" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
891.headline: A close look at the prizes
